replies.body:
Fair challenge — walking through it from your side, I think you're right. This test canonizes what asdict() happens to do, not a shape anyone chose, and the semconv reference corpus already votes for omission: the anthropic scenario fixtures record a bare compaction part as just {"type": "compaction"}.

One flag before dropping Nones at the shared layer: it can't be a blanket filter. ToolCallRequest.arguments / ToolCallResponse.response are Any-typed, where None can be a real value (a tool legitimately returning null vs no response recorded). The safe version drops only the Optional metadata fields (id, content) — which would also clean up the "id": null that ServerToolCall has emitted since 1.0b0, and beta seems like the right window for that. Happy either way on scoping: fold the small dict_factory into this PR and flip this test to assert {"type": "compaction"}, or land the type as-is minus this test and do the serializer as an immediate follow-up.

Could you please avoid excessive AI usage when talking to humans?

A good approach would be to encode it into semconv using pydantic / json schema properties where possible and special-casing tool call arguments / result. Once it's formalized in semconv, it should be ok to have per-property serialization choices.

For this PR, I'll be happy to merge with this test removed
